The Council of Europe adopted the Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy, and the Rule of Law on September sixteenth. Section three: tech geopolitics.

The Trump administration is reversing course on A I chip export controls, allowing U S suppliers to resume sales of advanced A I chips to China under a case by case review.
